Think Fast — Pair Race!
1) List 5 things you can ONLY do in summer.
sunbathe, swim outdoors, barbecue, picnic, beach volleyball, camping, water sports, etc.
2) List 5 things you can ONLY do in winter.
ski, snowboard, ice skating, build a snowman, drink hot cocoa by a fire, etc.
3) Name a comparative: "Winter is ___ than summer."
colder, darker, snowier, quieter, more peaceful, more magical, etc.
4) Name a comparative: "Summer is ___ than winter."
hotter, sunnier, busier, more colourful, more relaxing, more exciting, etc.

Vocabulary

New Words for Today

Click each card to see an example sentence.

nounadventure

An exciting or unusual experience

"My summer adventure was hiking in the mountains."
verbexplore

To travel to or around a new place

"We explored the old city centre on foot."
noundestination

The place where someone is going

"Our holiday destination was Barcelona."
nounmemory

Something you remember from the past

"I have wonderful memories of last winter."
adjbreathtaking

Very impressive or beautiful

"The view from the top was breathtaking."
verbcelebrate

To do something special for an event

"We celebrated New Year with fireworks."
verbvolunteer

To work without pay to help others

"I volunteered at an animal shelter last summer."
adjunforgettable

Something you will never forget

"It was an unforgettable trip to the coast."

Pronunciation Tip

"Volunteer" — stress on the 3rd syllable: vol-un-TEER

"Breathtaking" — stress on the 1st syllable: BREATH-tak-ing

Grammar

Present Simple vs Present Continuous

Two present tenses — two different meanings!

Present Simple

Habits, routines, facts

FormExample
+ S + V(s/es)I play tennis every week.
- S + don't/doesn't + VShe doesn't like winter.
? Do/Does + S + V?Do you travel often?
always usually every day

Present Continuous

Actions happening now, temporary

FormExample
+ S + am/is/are + V-ingI am studying right now.
- S + am/is/are + not + V-ingShe isn't working today.
? Am/Is/Are + S + V-ing?Are you listening?
now at the moment

Common Mistake

I am go to school every day. → I go to school every day.

Which tense? Click to reveal:

She ___ (work) in a bankworks (Present Simple)
They ___ (watch) TV noware watching (Continuous)
I ___ (not / go) on holiday this week'm not going (Continuous)
Grammar

Past Simple vs Future Simple

Looking back and looking forward!

Past Simple

Completed actions in the past

FormExample
+ S + V2/-edI visited Paris last year.
- S + didn't + VShe didn't go camping.
? Did + S + V?Did you enjoy the trip?

Future Simple (will)

Predictions, spontaneous decisions

FormExample
+ S + will + VI will travel next summer.
- S + won't + VShe won't come tomorrow.
? Will + S + V?Will you visit London?

Click to reveal:

We ___ (see) a film last nightsaw (Past Simple)
I ___ (help) you!'ll help (Future)
She ___ (not / buy) that souvenirdidn't buy (Past Simple)
Grammar

Present Perfect

Connecting past to present

When to Use

  • Life experiences
  • Recent actions (just, already, yet)
  • Duration (since/for)
FormExample
+ S + have/has + V3I have visited Rome.
- S + haven't/hasn't + V3She hasn't tried sushi.
? Have/Has + S + V3?Have you ever been abroad?
ever never just already yet since for

Present Perfect or Past Simple?

I ___ (never / eat) escargot've never eaten (Present Perfect)
We ___ (arrive) yesterdayarrived (Past Simple)
She ___ (just / finish) homework's just finished (Present Perfect)
Grammar

There is/are, Comparatives & First Conditional

Three essential structures

There is/are

Sing: There is a beach.

Pl: There are many restaurants.

Comparatives

Short: big → bigger

Long: beautiful → more beautiful

Irr: good → better

First Conditional

If + Present, will + V

If it rains, we will stay home.

Common Mistakes

There is three parks → There are | more big → bigger | If it will rain → If it rains

📍 There is/are — Practice
  • ___ a cafe near your house?
  • ___ many students in your class.
⚖ Comparatives — Practice
  • Winter is ___ (cold) than summer.
  • This book is ___ (interesting) than that one.
🔀 First Conditional — Practice
  • If I ___ (have) time, I ___ (call) you.
  • She ___ (be) happy if she ___ (pass) the exam.
Mini Check — Click each to reveal answers
Q1: Choose: There ___ (is/are) a lot of snow here in winter.
✅ is — "snow" is uncountable, so singular.
Q2: Correct the comparative: "This city is more clean than my city."
✅ cleaner — short adjectives use -er, not "more".
Q3: Fill: "If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we ___ (stay) home."
✅ rains, will stay — 1st Conditional rule.

Reading

A Summer to Remember

Last summer, my friend Anna and I decided to do something different. We have never been camping before, so we chose a beautiful destination in the mountains.

There is a wonderful lake near the campsite, and there are many hiking trails. Every morning, we wake up early and go for a walk. One day, we saw a family of deer — it was breathtaking!

The weather was warmer than we expected. Anna has already booked the same campsite for next summer. She says if the weather is good, she will invite more friends.

Comprehension:

1. What did they decide to do?Go camping in the mountains.
2. Had they been camping before?No, they had never been camping.
3. What did they see?A family of deer.
4. Find a comparative."warmer"

Production Task

My Season Update Presentation

Prepare a 2-minute mini-presentation. Use at least 4 different grammar structures!

Structure

1. Introduction — Where did you go? Past Simple
2. Daily Life — What do you usually do? Present Simple
3. Highlights — Best part? Present Perfect
4. Comparisons — Better/worse? Comparatives
5. Future Plans — Next time? 1st Conditional
💬 Useful Starter Phrases
• "Last summer/winter, I went to..."
• "I usually... but this time I..."
• "The best thing was... I have never..."
• "It was much more... than I expected."
• "If the weather is good, I will..."

Grammar Hints
  • every day/week/Tuesday → Present Simple
  • now, at the moment → Present Continuous
  • yesterday, last year, ago → Past Simple
  • ever, never, already, yet → Present Perfect
  • If + Present → will + V (1st Cond)
  • Short adj (hot) → hotter (-er)
  • Long adj (beautiful) → more beautiful

Quick Recap — Click to reveal:

Use breathtaking in a sentence about a holiday.e.g. "The view from the mountain was absolutely breathtaking."
Correct: "I am go to school every day."I go to school every day. (Present Simple, not Continuous)
Complete: "If it _____ (snow), we _____ (stay) inside."If it snows, we will stay inside. (1st Conditional)
Which is correct: "more tall" or "taller"?taller — short adjectives use -er, not "more".
Complete: "The film was ________ (good) than I expected."✅ better — irregular comparative: good → better.
Which tense? "We have lived here for 5 years."Present Perfect — duration from past to now (for/since).
Make a First Conditional: "I / be happy / if / I / pass / the exam".✅ "If I pass the exam, I will be happy." (If + Present, will + V).
Correct: "I go to school yesterday."I went to school yesterday. — Past Simple (finished past, yesterday).

Homework Worksheet

Task A — Gap-fill 15 pts
1. My sister ________ (go/goes/is going) to school by bus every day.
2. Be quiet! The baby ________ (sleeps/is sleeping/slept).
3. We ________ (visit/visited/have visited) the museum last weekend.
4. I think they ________ (will come/came/are coming) tomorrow.
5. She ________ (has never tried/never tries/didn't try) sushi before.
6. ________ (There is/There are/There was) a lot of parks here.
7. This book is ________ (more interesting/interestinger/most interesting) than the last one.
8. If we ________ (will leave/leave/left) early, we will arrive on time.
Answer Key

1. goes 2. is sleeping 3. visited 4. will come 5. has never tried 6. There are 7. more interesting 8. leave
